items.caption:
Can't sleep before a full moon? One study says it's not just you.
In a 2021 field study, sleep was shortest 3 to 5 days before a full moon, varying by 46 to 58 minutes across the cycle. Other studies are mixed. Next full moon: Mon Oct 26.
